products.name: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 — Commercial
products.short_description: The complete Microsoft Defender for Office 365 solution — enable your team on detect/hunt/respond and prove value, end to end.
products.description:
The complete Microsoft Defender for Office 365 solution — enable your team on detect/hunt/respond and prove value, end to end.

Blocking spam is table stakes; the value of Defender for Office 365 is post-delivery detection, response, and a team that can drive it. This comprehensive solution takes MDO end to end: hands-on enablement labs (Threat Explorer, Attack Simulation, automated investigation/response, email hunting) and a guided proof-of-concept with benign test signal — cross-referencing the existing MDO Plan-2 implementation and the EOP/MDO mail-hygiene solutions for the config baseline, so this focuses on operating and proving the product.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • End-to-end deployment & onboarding (config, coverage, pilot-first rollout)
  • Operations & optimization — tune, reduce noise, expand coverage, harden policy
  • Hands-on enablement labs to upskill your admins/SOC on the product
  • A guided proof-of-concept / pilot with benign test signal to prove value
  • Read-only discovery, validation & reporting scripts (PowerShell + KQL)

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A team-ready Defender for Office 365 operated for detection and response, with proven value — the enablement-and-prove lifecycle in one package.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MDOFULL-Discovery.ps1 — inventory readiness to operate, enable, and prove Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (read-only)
    • MDOFULL-Report.ps1 — report cohort progress + per-lab data, and capture the PoC evidence scorecard (read-only)
    • MDOFULL-RunLab.ps1 — run a chosen email hunting-lab query from MDOFULL-Labs.kql read-only
    • MDOFULL-TestSignal.ps1 — generate (or tear down) BENIGN, simulated email test signal for the MDO proof of concept. -WhatIf-gated
    • MDOFULL-Validate.ps1 — run the MDO enable-and-prove pass/fail gates and score the knowledge-check (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
